result.summary: The food delivery home screen appears well-formed overall. Excluding the allowed carousel and viewport clipping, no clear visual defects were found; only minor observations remain.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is only ~4.5% of the screen height from the home indicator, and the inactive tab icons (Search, Orders, Profile) use a light gray that may have low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Verify the inactive tab label/icon color meets WCAG contrast requirements (at least 3:1 for icons, 4.5:1 for text).
